correctness.rationale: The two adjacent dyadic cylinders map to complementary almost-alternating itinerary words under negative doubling. Their equality-defect transforms avoid the single pattern \(10^{m-2}\), giving an exact last-one renewal recurrence and rational generating function. Primitive renewal Perron theory yields a sharp m=4 positive-entropy onset; a cylinder/Frostman argument gives dimension. Bernoulli cylinder weights give the exact n-step survival measure, and controlled implicit expansion of \(t(1-t)^{m-2}=2^{1-m}\) gives the logarithmically enhanced correction. Exact rational finite enumeration and high-precision checks confirm boundary cases but are not substituted for the proof.

value.rationale: This is a natural symmetric sequence converging to the critical discontinuity in a current negative-Lorenz-map problem. It yields a sharp structural zero/positive entropy onset, every finite-time survival probability rather than merely asymptotic existence, exact dimension, and the coefficient of a nonanalytic shrinking-hole correction. The discrete entropy transition and all-depth renewal mechanism are not arbitrary small-parameter tables, and the coefficient is not claimed to introduce logarithmic escape corrections generally.
